items.jp: 今日は二時限分の授業があります。
semantic_checks: 二時限分 expresses a quantity of two class periods and has no ordinal suffix 目.
The sentence says that classes amounting to two periods are available today; it does not mean the second period.
Do not change this duration or quantity into a class-period ordinal.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not name the subjects or say who attends the classes.

stable: The sentence refers to class periods and includes the number two.
changed: 分 marks a two-period quantity; the ordinal suffix 目 is absent.
limits: Two periods are a quantity, not a position in a day's schedule.
